resolved_findings.detail: Both nested input and outer request serialize fail-closed under transient and persistent Jansson allocation failures; independent differential reproduction fails base and passes reviewed fix.

scope.boundary: Narrow fix review of checked serialization plus final worker normal/sanitizer regression bar, not a repeat of prior complete reviews.
excluded: Model quality or server schema enforcement
scope.network: No live calls, pulls, installs or inference. Only isolated container loopback tests.

inspection.production_delta: Only checked_dumps helper and two call substitutions. Removing helper and reversing substitutions reproduces base interpreter.c byte-for-byte. Endpoint, deadlines, prompt, schema, strict response validator, transport and scheduling unchanged.
inspection.serialization: Measured bounded json_dumpb sink avoids json_dumps buffer-growth failures. Rejects zero/SIZE_MAX size, allocation failure and incomplete second traversal; terminates only complete result. No new parser or global allocator mutation in production.
inspection.ownership: All tested transient/persistent paths leave zero tracked Jansson allocations; helper frees failed output using Jansson release function. Existing default-allocator contract unchanged.
inspection.regression_test: Checked repository regression assertions include outer+inner semantic equality, transient and persistent sweep, allocation accounting; independently rerun rather than accepting supplied logs.

testresults.fixtures: structured on/off x evidence counts 1,8,16; UINT64_MAX; escaped IDs and model; all four source labels; UTF-8 including non-BMP; maximum 1024-byte evidence text on 8/16 fixtures.
testresults.oracle: Separate host Python json parser with duplicate-key rejection checks outer and inner semantic equality after construction, and fixed non-failing outputs equal base non-failing outputs. C asserts zero outstanding allocations each iteration. Probe exit alone is not an integrity result (base exits 0 but oracle rejects six outputs).
testresults.diagnostics: No ASan/UBSan/LSan diagnostics in independent fixed/base probes or final sanitized suite.

reproduction.suite_command: docker run --rm --pull never --network none --user 1000:1000 -e ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1:halt_on_error=1 -e UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1 -v <worker>:/src:ro -w /src recursant-v4-dev:local sh -c "cmake -S . -B /tmp/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug [ -DRECURSANT_SANITIZERS=ON ] && cmake --build /tmp/build -j4 && ctest --test-dir /tmp/build -R interpreter -V && ctest --test-dir /tmp/build --output-on-failure"
